description: Check a company before invoicing or paying it, in one call: active or closed (French registry), EU VAT number valid (VIES), insolvency proceedings (BODACC: liquidation, redressement, sauvegarde), asset-freeze and sanctions match (DG Trésor register, incl. EU and UN), and optional IBAN checksum, country and SEPA. Returns a verdict ok / review / block with reasons; on review or block, ask a human. From a SIREN, SIRET, EU VAT number or French company name. 0.02 USDC per call, charged only if found.

vat.description: EU VAT number, e.g. FR27552032534 or DE123456789

name: counterparty_check
